doc.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Slugs with Joe Henderson, Chick Corea; Sonny Rollins at the Audubon
summary: He led bands with Joe Henderson and Chick Corea at Slugs, and one with Sonny Rollins and Kenny Dorham at the Audubon.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I had Joe down at Slugs with me. In fact, I got some – somewhere around here I got some reel-to-reel of a little of that, if one of my slick sons didn’t take it and do something with it. I was looking for that. I had some people interviewing me. I was looking for it. I couldn’t find it then. I got some reel-to-reel way upstairs on the fifth floor. I had some good bands. I had one band with Sonny Rollins, Kenny Dorham, at the Audubon Ballroom.
What year would that have been about?
That was late ’50s, in the ’50s, after Sarah.
